items.headline: Verstappen takes Singapore Sprint pole, keeps it after yellow-flag probe
items.summary: Max edged George Russell (in the older-spec Mercedes) by 0.12s, with Leclerc, Piastri, Norris and Hamilton next. Stewards agreed he passed Hamilton under yellows in SQ1 but blamed the closing speed and gave no penalty.

items.headline: Messy session: Race Control error and Mercedes upgrade woes
items.summary: The FIA admitted Overtake Mode was wrongly left active for 27 seconds after a red flag, which Sainz says cost him. Antonelli was only seventh in the upgraded W17, while Russell faces a grid penalty for Sunday's race.

items.headline: OpenAI revenue reportedly $20bn short of projections
items.summary: A fresh report says OpenAI's revenue is tracking well below what it had forecast — awkward timing in the week it launched GPT-6.

items.headline: Tesla drops 'Full Self-Driving' name in Europe
items.summary: The driver-assist package is being rebranded 'Tesla Assisted Driving' for European markets, a less autonomous-sounding label.

items.headline: Batteries now undercut gas turbines for many data centres
items.summary: Battery storage has become cheaper than the natural-gas turbines many data centres use for power — relevant as AI build-outs strain grids.

items.headline: Three CMEs inbound — aurora chances this weekend
items.summary: Several coronal mass ejections are heading for Earth and could boost northern lights into the weekend; worth a look north from Ireland if skies clear.

items.headline: Another dead Soviet satellite breaks apart in orbit
items.summary: The latest fragmentation in low Earth orbit adds to a run of similar break-ups that experts say is a worrying debris trend.

items.headline: NASA hunts for a lunar cave to shelter astronauts
items.summary: NASA is searching for a possible underground cave on the Moon that could protect future crews from radiation and temperature swings.

items.headline: Cyberpunk 2077 movie in the works at Paramount
items.summary: Deadline reports a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film is being developed at Paramount with Transformers producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura. No word on Project Orion itself; rest of the watchlist is quiet.

items.headline: Victor Hugo hints at ADCC retirement
items.summary: The ADCC 2026 +99kg champion says he may be done with the event, citing an uncertain future and recovery doubts — though he left the door open for ADCC 2028 in Brazil.

items.headline: UFC Vegas 122 weigh-ins: three misses, main event on
items.summary: Ismael Bonfim came in 7.5lb heavy for Francisco Prado, with Brendson Ribeiro and Ketlen Souza also over. Allen vs Duncan is set, and Jai Herbert made weight for Camilo. Main card ~01:00 Sunday Irish time.
